B.title: OpenRTAG: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Robust Text-Attributed Graph Learning under Data Quality Degradation
B.tldr: OpenRTAG provides a standardized testbed for understanding robustness in TAG learning under realistic low-quality settings and systematically evaluates scenario validity and model sensitivity, compares traditional GNNs, LLM-GNNs, and a representative GFM, and investigates the effectiveness, efficiency, and robustness of scenario-matched baselines.

B.title: TEG-DB: A Comprehensive Dataset and Benchmark of Textual-Edge Graphs
B.tldr: This work introduces Textual-Edge Graphs Datasets and Benchmark (TEG-DB), a comprehensive and diverse collection of benchmark textual-edge datasets featuring rich textual descriptions on nodes and edges to enhance graph analysis and provide deeper insights into complex real-world networks.
